verses.original: Ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ οἱ μαθηταὶ προσῆλθον τῷ Ἰησοῦ λέγοντες Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: En ekeinē tē hōra hoi mathētai prosēlthon tō Iēsou legontes Tis ara estin meizōn en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: At that - time the disciples came - to Jesus [and] asked Who then is [the] greatest in the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ ἐν αὐτῶν μέσῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai proskalesamenos paidion estēsen auto en autōn mesō
verses.literal: - [Jesus] invited a little child to stand . . . vvv vvv among them

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν μὴ στραφῆτε καὶ γένησθε ὡς τὰ παιδία οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin kai eipen ean mē straphēte kai genēsthe hōs ta paidia ou mē eiselthēte eis tēn basileian tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you - He said unless . . . you change and become like - little children vvv vvv you will never enter . . . the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: οὖν ὅστις ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὡς τοῦτο τὸ παιδίον οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μείζων ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: oun hostis tapeinōsei heauton hōs touto to paidion houtos estin ho meizōn en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: Therefore whoever humbles himself like this - little child - is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται ἓν παιδίον τοιοῦτο ἐπὶ μου τῷ ὀνόματί δέχεται ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: kai hos ean dexētai hen paidion toiouto epi mou tō onomati dechetai eme
verses.literal: And whoever vvv welcomes a little child like this in My - name welcomes Me

verses.original: δ’ ἂν Ὃς σκανδαλίσῃ ἕνα τούτων τῶν μικρῶν τῶν πιστευόντων εἰς ἐμέ συμφέρει αὐτῷ ἵνα ὀνικὸς μύλος κρεμασθῇ περὶ αὐτοῦ τὸν τράχηλον καὶ καταποντισθῇ ἐν τῷ πελάγει τῆς θαλάσσης
verses.transliteration: d’ an Hos skandalisē hena toutōn tōn mikrōn tōn pisteuontōn eis eme sympherei autō hina onikos mylos kremasthē peri autou ton trachēlon kai katapontisthē en tō pelagei tēs thalassēs
verses.literal: But if anyone causes one of these - little ones who believe in Me {to stumble} it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his - neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea

verses.original: Οὐαὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἀπὸ τῶν σκανδάλων γὰρ τὰ σκάνδαλα ἀνάγκη ἐλθεῖν πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ δι’ οὗ τὸ σκάνδαλον ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: Ouai tō kosmō apo tōn skandalōn gar ta skandala anankē elthein plēn ouai tō anthrōpō di’ hou to skandalon erchetai
verses.literal: Woe to the world for the causes of sin - [These] stumbling blocks must come but woe to the man through whom - [they] come

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ σου ἡ χείρ ἢ σου ὁ πούς σκανδαλίζει σε ἔκκοψον αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ ἐστιν καλόν σοί εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν κυλλὸν ἢ χωλόν ἢ ἔχοντα δύο χεῖρας ἢ δύο πόδας βληθῆναι εἰς τὸ τὸ αἰώνιον πῦρ
verses.transliteration: de Ei sou hē cheir ē sou ho pous skandalizei se ekkopson auton kai bale apo sou estin kalon soi eiselthein eis tēn zōēn kyllon ē chōlon ē echonta dyo cheiras ē dyo podas blēthēnai eis to to aiōnion pyr
verses.literal: - If your - hand or your - foot causes you to sin . . . cut it off . . . and throw it away . . . . . . It is better for you to enter . . . - life crippled or lame than to have two hands [and] two feet [and] be thrown into the - eternal fire

verses.original: καὶ εἰ σου ὁ ὀφθαλμός σκανδαλίζει σε ἔξελε αὐτὸν καὶ βάλε ἀπὸ σοῦ ἐστιν καλόν σοί εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν ζωὴν μονόφθαλμον ἢ ἔχοντα δύο ὀφθαλμοὺς βληθῆναι εἰς τὴν πυρός τοῦ γέενναν
verses.transliteration: kai ei sou ho ophthalmos skandalizei se exele auton kai bale apo sou estin kalon soi eiselthein eis tēn zōēn monophthalmon ē echonta dyo ophthalmous blēthēnai eis tēn pyros tou geennan
verses.literal: And if your - eye causes you to sin . . . gouge it out . . . and throw it away . . . . . . It is better for you to enter . . . - life with one eye than to have two eyes [and] be thrown into the fire of hell

verses.original: Ὁρᾶτε μὴ καταφρονήσητε ἑνὸς τούτων τῶν μικρῶν γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι αὐτῶν οἱ ἄγγελοι ἐν οὐρανοῖς διὰ παντὸς βλέπουσι τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ μου Πατρός τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: Horate mē kataphronēsēte henos toutōn tōn mikrōn gar legō hymin hoti autōn hoi angeloi en ouranois dia pantos blepousi to prosōpon tou mou Patros tou en ouranois
verses.literal: See [that] vvv you do not look down on any of these - little ones For I tell you that their - angels in heaven always . . . see the face of My Father - in heaven

verses.original: Τί ὑμῖν δοκεῖ ἐὰν τινι ἀνθρώπῳ γένηταί ἑκατὸν πρόβατα καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν πλανηθῇ οὐχὶ ἀφήσει τὰ ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη καὶ πορευθεὶς ζητεῖ τὸ πλανώμενον
verses.transliteration: Ti hymin dokei ean tini anthrōpō genētai hekaton probata kai hen ex autōn planēthē ouchi aphēsei ta enenēkonta ennea epi ta orē kai poreutheis zētei to planōmenon
verses.literal: What {do} you think If a man has a hundred sheep and one of them goes astray vvv will he not leave the ninety-nine . . . on the hills and go out to search for the [one] that is lost

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν γένηται εὑρεῖν αὐτό ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι χαίρει μᾶλλον ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἢ ἐπὶ τοῖς ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα τοῖς μὴ πεπλανημένοις
verses.transliteration: kai ean genētai heurein auto amēn legō hymin hoti chairei mallon ep’ autō ē epi tois enenēkonta ennea tois mē peplanēmenois
verses.literal: And if he finds it truly I tell you - he rejoices more over [that one sheep] than over the ninety-nine . . . - vvv that did not go astray

verses.original: οὕτως ἔμπροσθεν ὑμῶν τοῦ Πατρὸς τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς ἔστιν οὐκ θέλημα ἵνα ἓν τούτων τῶν μικρῶν ἀπόληται
verses.transliteration: houtōs emprosthen hymōn tou Patros tou en ouranois estin ouk thelēma hina hen toutōn tōn mikrōn apolētai
verses.literal: In the same way - your - Father - in heaven is not willing that any of these - little ones should perish

verses.original: δὲ Ἐὰν σου ὁ ἀδελφός ἁμαρτήσῃ εἰς σὲ ὕπαγε ἔλεγξον αὐτὸν μόνου μεταξὺ σοῦ καὶ αὐτοῦ ἐάν ἀκούσῃ σου ἐκέρδησας σου τὸν ἀδελφόν
verses.transliteration: de Ean sou ho adelphos hamartēsē eis se hypage elenxon auton monou metaxy sou kai autou ean akousē sou ekerdēsas sou ton adelphon
verses.literal: - If your - brother sins against you go [and] confront him privately . . . . . . . . . . . . If he listens to you you have won your - brother {over}

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ παράλαβε ἕνα ἢ δύο ἔτι μετὰ σοῦ ἵνα πᾶν ῥῆμα σταθῇ Ἐπὶ στόματος δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: de ean mē akousē paralabe hena ē dyo eti meta sou hina pan rhēma stathē Epi stomatos dyo ē triōn martyrōn
verses.literal: But if - he will not listen take one or two others along . . . so that every matter may be established by [the] testimony of two or three witnesses

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν παρακούσῃ αὐτῶν εἰπὸν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ δὲ ἐὰν παρακούσῃ καὶ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἔστω ὥσπερ σοι ὁ ἐθνικὸς καὶ ὁ τελώνης
verses.transliteration: de ean parakousē autōn eipon tē ekklēsia de ean parakousē kai tēs ekklēsias estō hōsper soi ho ethnikos kai ho telōnēs
verses.literal: - If he refuses to listen to them tell [it] to the church And if he refuses to listen even to the church regard [him] as you [would] a pagan [or] - a tax collector

verses.original: Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅσα ἐὰν δήσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται δεδεμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν λύσητε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἔσται λελυμένα ἐν οὐρανῷ
verses.transliteration: Amēn legō hymin hosa ean dēsēte epi tēs gēs estai dedemena en ouranō kai hosa ean lysēte epi tēs gēs estai lelymena en ouranō
verses.literal: Truly I tell you whatever . . . you bind on - earth will be bound in heaven and whatever . . . you loose on - earth will be loosed in heaven

verses.original: Πάλιν λέγω ὑμῖν ἀμὴν ὅτι ἐὰν δύο ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συμφωνήσωσιν περὶ παντὸς πράγματος οὗ ἐὰν αἰτήσωνται γενήσεται αὐτοῖς παρὰ μου τοῦ Πατρός τοῦ ἐν οὐρανοῖς
verses.transliteration: Palin legō hymin amēn hoti ean dyo ex hymōn epi tēs gēs symphōnēsōsin peri pantos pragmatos hou ean aitēsōntai genēsetai autois para mou tou Patros tou en ouranois
verses.literal: Again I tell you truly that if two of you on the earth agree about anything . . . - vvv [you] ask for it will be done for [you] by My - Father - in heaven

verses.original: γάρ οὗ δύο ἢ τρεῖς εἰσιν συνηγμένοι εἰς ἐμὸν τὸ ὄνομα ἐκεῖ εἰμι ἐν αὐτῶν μέσῳ
verses.transliteration: gar hou dyo ē treis eisin synēgmenoi eis emon to onoma ekei eimi en autōn mesō
verses.literal: For where two or three vvv gather together in My - name there am I with them . . . . . .

verses.original: Τότε Πέτρος προσελθὼν αὐτῷ ὁ εἶπεν Κύριε ποσάκις καὶ ἀφήσω αὐτῷ ἐμὲ ὁ ἀδελφός ἁμαρτήσει εἰς μου ἕως ἑπτάκις
verses.transliteration: Tote Petros proselthōn autō ho eipen Kyrie posakis kai aphēsō autō eme ho adelphos hamartēsei eis mou heōs heptakis
verses.literal: Then Peter came to [Jesus] - [and] asked Lord how many times - shall I forgive - my - brother who sins against me Up to seven times

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ λέγω σοι Οὐ ἕως ἑπτάκις ἀλλὰ ἕως ἑβδομηκοντάκις ἑπτά
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō legō soi Ou heōs heptakis alla heōs hebdomēkontakis hepta
verses.literal: - Jesus answered . . . I tell you not just seven times but - seventy-seven times . . .

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν ὡμοιώθη ἀνθρώπῳ βασιλεῖ ὃς ἠθέλησεν συνᾶραι λόγον μετὰ αὐτοῦ τῶν δούλων
verses.transliteration: Dia touto hē basileia tōn ouranōn hōmoiōthē anthrōpō basilei hos ēthelēsen synarai logon meta autou tōn doulōn
verses.literal: Because of this the kingdom of heaven is like - a king who wanted to settle accounts with his - servants

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ ἀρξαμένου συναίρειν εἷς ὀφειλέτης μυρίων ταλάντων προσηνέχθη αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de autou arxamenou synairein heis opheiletēs myriōn talantōn prosēnechthē autō
verses.literal: As he began the settlements a debtor owing ten thousand talents was brought to him

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ μὴ ἔχοντος ἀποδοῦναι ὁ κύριος ἐκέλευσεν αὐτὸν πραθῆναι καὶ ἀποδοθῆναι καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα καὶ τὰ τέκνα καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἔχει
verses.transliteration: de autou mē echontos apodounai ho kyrios ekeleusen auton prathēnai kai apodothēnai kai tēn gynaika kai ta tekna kai panta hosa echei
verses.literal: Since [the man] vvv was unable to pay the master ordered that he be sold - to pay [his] debt along with [his] wife and - children and everything - he owned

verses.original: οὖν ὁ δοῦλος Πεσὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί λέγων καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι πάντα
verses.transliteration: oun ho doulos Pesōn prosekynei autō Makrothymēson ep’ emoi legōn kai apodōsō soi panta
verses.literal: Then the servant fell on his knees before him Have patience with me he begged and I will pay back everything

verses.original: δὲ ὁ κύριος ἐκείνου τοῦ δούλου Σπλαγχνισθεὶς καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ τὸ δάνειον ἀπέλυσεν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de ho kyrios ekeinou tou doulou Splanchnistheis kai aphēken autō to daneion apelysen auton
verses.literal: - [His] master - - - had compassion [on him] - forgave his - debt [and] released him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἐκεῖνος δοῦλος Ἐξελθὼν εὗρεν ἕνα αὐτοῦ τῶν συνδούλων ὃς ὤφειλεν αὐτῷ ἑκατὸν δηνάρια καὶ κρατήσας αὐτὸν ἔπνιγεν λέγων Ἀπόδος εἴ τι ὀφείλεις
verses.transliteration: de ho ekeinos doulos Exelthōn heuren hena autou tōn syndoulōn hos ōpheilen autō hekaton dēnaria kai kratēsas auton epnigen legōn Apodos ei ti opheileis
verses.literal: But when - that servant went out he found one of his - fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii - He grabbed him and began to choke [him] saying Pay back what you owe [me]

verses.original: οὖν αὐτοῦ ὁ σύνδουλος Πεσὼν παρεκάλει αὐτὸν λέγων Μακροθύμησον ἐπ’ ἐμοί καὶ ἀποδώσω σοι
verses.transliteration: oun autou ho syndoulos Pesōn parekalei auton legōn Makrothymēson ep’ emoi kai apodōsō soi
verses.literal: So his - fellow servant fell down [and] begged him - Have patience with me and I will pay you {back}

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ οὐκ ἤθελεν ἀλλὰ ἀπελθὼν ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακὴν ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ τὸ ὀφειλόμενον
verses.transliteration: de Ho ouk ēthelen alla apelthōn ebalen auton eis phylakēn heōs hou apodō to opheilomenon
verses.literal: But - vvv he refused Instead he went [and] had [the man] thrown . . . into prison until . . . he could pay [his] debt

verses.original: οὖν αὐτοῦ οἱ σύνδουλοι Ἰδόντες τὰ γενόμενα σφόδρα ἐλυπήθησαν καὶ ἐλθόντες διεσάφησαν πάντα τὰ γενόμενα τῷ ἑαυτῶν κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: oun autou hoi syndouloi Idontes ta genomena sphodra elypēthēsan kai elthontes diesaphēsan panta ta genomena tō heautōn kyriō
verses.literal: [When] his - fellow servants saw what had happened vvv they were greatly distressed and they went [and] recounted all - [of this] to their master

verses.original: Τότε αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος προσκαλεσάμενος αὐτὸν λέγει αὐτῷ πονηρέ Δοῦλε ἀφῆκά σοι πᾶσαν ἐκείνην τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἐπεὶ παρεκάλεσάς με
verses.transliteration: Tote autou ho kyrios proskalesamenos auton legei autō ponēre Doule aphēka soi pasan ekeinēn tēn opheilēn epei parekalesas me
verses.literal: Then - the master summoned him [and] said - [You] wicked servant I forgave - all [your] - debt because you begged me

verses.original: ἔδει οὐκ σὲ καὶ ἐλεῆσαι σου τὸν σύνδουλόν ὡς κἀγὼ ἠλέησα σὲ
verses.transliteration: edei ouk se kai eleēsai sou ton syndoulon hōs kagō ēleēsa se
verses.literal: Shouldn’t . . . you - have had mercy on your - fellow servant just as I [had] on you

verses.original: καὶ ὀργισθεὶς αὐτοῦ ὁ κύριος παρέδωκεν αὐτὸν τοῖς βασανισταῖς ἕως οὗ ἀποδῷ πᾶν τὸ ὀφειλόμενον αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai orgistheis autou ho kyrios paredōken auton tois basanistais heōs hou apodō pan to opheilomenon autō
verses.literal: - In anger his - master turned him over . . . to the jailers to be tortured until - he should repay all that he owed -

verses.original: Οὕτως καὶ μου ὁ οὐράνιος ὁ Πατήρ ποιήσει ἕκαστος ὑμῖν ἐὰν μὴ ἀφῆτε αὐτοῦ τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἀπὸ ὑμῶν τῶν καρδιῶν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs kai mou ho ouranios ho Patēr poiēsei hekastos hymin ean mē aphēte autou tō adelphō apo hymōn tōn kardiōn
verses.literal: That is how - My - heavenly - Father will treat each of you unless . . . you forgive [your] - brother from your - heart
